He loves to study emerging solutions and applications mainly related to big data processing, NoSQL, natural language processing, and neural networks. He is also the Project Technical Lead for the OPNFV Apex Installer project, and a committer on several other OPNFV projects. He is active in many OpenStack projects including the TripleO OpenStack project, OpenStack Puppet Modules, as well as the OpenDaylight project. His main goals are enabling and driving new technologies around NFV and SDN with OpenStack – including OpenDaylight, FD.IO, Service Function Chaining, and OVS DPDK.
